chapter: Cab Calloway's band, Hadacol and closing reflections
title: Cab shows Dizzy his scar in Nice
summary: Years later in Nice Cab pulled down his pants to show Dizzy the scar, and they are friends now.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong

blocks.x: But last year, the year before last, we were in Nice. Dizzy was in Nice, Cab was there and Earl Hines was there. And we were standing in the lobby of the hotel,

and Cab called Dizzy. "Come here for just a minute." And Cab went over in the corner and pulled his pants down, and said, "Give me your hand," and put his hand... "You see that? Feel that what you did to me." And there was a little scar there. He showed Dizzy... But they're good friends now, you know.
Well, right after that, I saw them... It wasn't a week later. Dizzy passed where the bus was...
Yeah. And Dizzy came over and said, "Hello" and everything.
He went with Earl Hines then.
